# /sensecrew-team — SenseCrew (Sensing-Games XP team)

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/sensecrew-team`; it goes to the lead.

## Purpose

Sensing-games / training-simulation team of 18 XP pairs (Driver + Navigator), deterministic seeded sims with a Godot 4 client over a Python/Rust science core.

## Routing

Everything goes through Sense-Strata, who plans, delegates, sets swarm budgets (max 100 subagents), gates merges and keeps the LEDGER. Pairs report to Strata.

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-sense-strata`.
